propositions: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md incorrectly state that the close precheck requires a MERGED rebar-ticket commit, when it actually accepts any commit reachable from HEAD regardless of merge status

The close precheck is conditional on recorded file_impact and a completion-verification gate, but the docs present it as unconditional, omitting early-return cases (gate off, --force-close, live replacement link)
rebar transition --ref is documented in help text and plan-review-gate.md but not mentioned in AGENTS.md, leading operators to skip it when closing stacked stories from non-epic checkouts
The precheck searches a commit subtree (ticket plus all transitive descendants) not a single ticket id, and this multiplicity is undocumented
The land-before-close ordering is enforced by the Verified +1 policy rule, not by the precheck mechanism, but the docs attribute it to the precheck and obscure the real policy constraint
The referencing-commit scan runs git log with no --ref argument regardless of whether transition --ref is used, so --ref retargets only verification and signature, not the commit search
